title: Magic Eden Bitcoin/Runes API and backend services discontinued
summary: The Magic Eden Help Center says the Bitcoin/Runes API and related backend services were fully shut down after March 27, 2026. Developers were directed to export data and migrate dependencies; Magic Eden did not offer alternative infrastructure.
migration_path: Export needed historical/API data and move integrations to an independently selected alternative. Magic Eden offers no official migration tooling.
user_impact: Bitcoin/Runes integrations dependent on Magic Eden backend services are no longer supported; remaining Solana API endpoints are outside this event.
notes: The official source documenting the effective date was published on June 30; original announcement date not established.
